lineage.description: Building footprints and attributes were extracted from OpenStreetMap for Anguilla through the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT) Raw Data API. The dataset represents approximately 84% of total buildings based on AI-mapped estimates, with an average data age of 2 years and continuous updates from the OSM volunteer community.
